name: Causal Discovery (Static)
description: Infer cause-and-effect relationships among variables from observational data measured at a single point in time.

name: sachs
description: The data consist in the simultaneous measurements of 11 phosphorylated proteins and phospholipids derived from thousands of individual primary immune system cells, subjected to both general and specific molecular interventions.

name: pc
description: PC algorithm: A classic causal discovery algorithm based on conditional independence tests.

variant.description: A variant of PC-algorithm, one of [`original`, `stable`, `parallel`].

ci_test.description: ci_test method, if str, must be one of [`fisherz`, `g2`, `chi2`]

name: accuracy_static
description: Accuracy metric for static causal graph.

binarize.description: Binarize the ground truth and predictions
